sloka: प्रासाद अग्रैः विमानैः वा वैहायस गतेन वा ।सर्व अवस्था गता भर्तुः पादच् चाया विशिष्यते ॥२-२७-८॥
transliteration: prāsāda agraiḥ vimānaiḥ vā vaihāyasa gatena vā ।sarva avasthā gatā bhartuḥ pādac cāyā viśiṣyate ॥2-27-8॥

translations.english: Every woman, everywhere be it on the top of mansions or in lovely palaces or flying in the sky should take shelter at his (her husband's) feet (or follow his footsteps).
